exclusives.description: Food/grocery/produce/dairy/bakery/meat/deli exclusive; restaurant within 250 ft; liquor store; and pharmacy — each with the Walgreens 'Retail H' carve-out and a 30% incidental-bakery allowance.

modifications.change: Waived to permit a Crumbl Cookies (~2,000 SF) to sell cookies + ancillary ice cream

goDark.value: Permitted — not a default. 'Go Dark' = 365 consecutive days with no business. Landlord's only remedy: within 365 days, notice to terminate unless reopened within 180 days; if it terminates, Landlord pays Tenant the unamortized cost of improvements/FF&E (prorated by remaining term).

assignment.value: Tenant may assign/sublet without Landlord consent (≤2 units; non-supermarket assignee may not violate an existing >20,000 SF exclusive). Landlord recapture only if the whole premises is assigned/subleased to a Nonsupermarket Operator (30-day termination election). §18(c): option exercises require SUPERVALU Holdings' signature; no assignment releases Tenant or any guarantor.

camTax.value: CAM: Pro-Rata Share (Building Area ÷ all S/C buildings, denominator ≥ Building Area + 50,000 SF; Wal-Mart Parcel & Outlots excluded); 5% admin fee, management fee & capital excluded; monthly estimate + annual reconciliation; audit right (overstatement >3% → Landlord pays audit). Taxes: Pro-Rata Share with construction/TIF and Wal-Mart/Outlot exclusions.

defaultTerms.value: Monetary default: 10 business days after notice. Non-monetary: 30 days after notice (extended if not reasonably curable). No implied obligations.

leaseNotes.label: Exclusive Use
leaseNotes.value: LL agrees that, with the exception of the Premises, no part of the S/C shall be used or operated for: (a) Food Sales — a supermarket or store/department selling food, groceries, fruit, produce, dairy, vegetables, bakery goods, meats or deli items (other tenants may sell bakery goods incidentally if ≤30% of their S/C sales; does not apply to 'Retail H' while the 60-yr Walgreens Lease is in effect); (b) Restaurant within 250 ft of a Building entrance/exit (Outlot A and Shops permitted; Shops entrances must face Touhy Ave); (c) Liquor store / off-premises beer-wine-liquor (except Retail H while Walgreens Lease in effect); (d) Drug store or pharmacy (except within Retail H). Remedy: injunctive or other equitable relief in addition to other remedies.

leaseNotes.label: Co-tenancy
leaseNotes.value: None

leaseNotes.label: Kickout/Termination (LL)
leaseNotes.value: None

leaseNotes.label: Kickout/Termination (Tenant)
leaseNotes.value: None

leaseNotes.label: LL Restrictions
leaseNotes.value: LL not to erect any building/structure/kiosk or other improvement in the S/C except within the building envelopes (one building per Outlot permitted). No improvement other than the Building shall (a) exceed one story; (b) have rooftop equipment unless screened to Tenant's satisfaction; or (c) have a rooftop sign (building façade signage excepted).

leaseNotes.label: Tenant Restrictions
leaseNotes.value: Tenant not to use the Premises for: (a) unlawful purposes; (b) hazardous activities; (c) nuisance/offensive conditions (permitted supermarket/floral/video/liquor/bank/pharmacy/gas-station/satellite uses excepted); (d) adult entertainment/obscene material; (e) bankruptcy/fire/auction sales (one 4-week GOB sale allowed); (f) auto/truck/trailer/RV sales, lease, display or repair; (g) bars/taverns (incidental restaurant alcohol excepted); (h) pawn/flea/second-hand/surplus/thrift; (i) health/fitness/sports/dance within 250 ft or >10,000 SF in aggregate; (j) theaters, carnivals, car washes, game rooms, betting, bowling, vet hospitals, funeral parlors, schools, post offices, lawn & garden centers.

leaseNotes.label: CAM Method
leaseNotes.value: Pro-Rata = Building Area ÷ rentable feet of all S/C buildings (mezzanines for non-sales excluded; denominator never less than Building Area + 50,000 SF; Wal-Mart Parcel and Outlots excluded). 5% administrative fee; no additional admin/management/overhead/profit fees. Monthly estimate with annual reconciliation. Management fee and capital repairs excluded. Audit: Tenant may audit; overstatement >3% → Landlord reimburses audit cost.

leaseNotes.label: Tax Method
leaseNotes.value: Pro-Rata Share (same method as CAM). Excludes construction-related special assessments; TIF/special-district taxes (except under the 10/27/1998 Redevelopment Agreement, TIF up to $4,000,000); and taxes on the Wal-Mart Parcel or any Outlot.

leaseNotes.label: Insurance Method
leaseNotes.value: Standard insurance clause (Sec. 13). Liability $2M CSL (deductible not to exceed $1M); Property: All Risk, 100% replacement value. Tenant may use a blanket policy or self-insure only if Tenant and any guarantor have a combined net worth ≥ $100,000,000. Carrier rating ≥ A- / Class X. 30-day cancellation notice; certificate ≥30 days before expiry.

leaseNotes.label: Assignment & Sublet
leaseNotes.value: Assign/sublet without Landlord consent (≤2 units; a non-supermarket assignee may not breach an existing >20,000 SF exclusive). Landlord recapture only on assignment/sublease of the whole premises to a Nonsupermarket Operator (30-day termination election). §18(c): option exercises require SUPERVALU Holdings' signature; no assignment releases Tenant or guarantor.

leaseNotes.label: Operating Covenant
leaseNotes.value: None — Tenant may go dark (see Go Dark).

leaseNotes.label: Go Dark Option
leaseNotes.value: Permitted; not a default. 'Go Dark' = 365 consecutive days with no business. Landlord may, within 365 days, notice termination unless reopened within 180 days; on termination Landlord pays Tenant the unamortized cost of improvements/FF&E (prorated by remaining term). Miss the 365-day window and the termination right lapses.

leaseNotes.label: Default
leaseNotes.value: Monetary: 10 business days after notice. Non-monetary: 30 days after notice (extended if not reasonably curable and Tenant is diligently curing).

flags.issue: Assignment-embedded $25M net-worth test on option exercises
flags.detail: The 2007/2008 assignment instruments bar option exercise, while Supervalu remains contingently liable, unless the assignee shows >$25M tangible net worth. Confirm satisfied for the 2019 and 2025 exercises.

flags.issue: Current force of the SUPERVALU Inc. guaranty is uncertain

narrative: Fresh Farms International Market (tenant of record Niles Grand LLC) anchors Pointe Plaza in Niles, IL under a 2/11/1999 Shopping Center Lease originally signed by SUPERVALU Holdings (Cub Foods) and guaranteed by SUPERVALU Inc. The lease passed through three assignments — Hawk/Cerberus (2006), MS-Grand/Kang (2007), and Niles Grand/Svigos (2008) — each adding a guaranty layer. 58,000 SF; 20-year initial term from a 2/23/2000 rent commencement, four 5-year options (first two exercised → through 12/31/2030 at $841,000/yr; $/SF steps to $15.50 by the 4th option). Strong tenant protections: a broad food/grocery/dairy/bakery exclusive (§9.3, narrowed by a 2022 Crumbl waiver), a go-dark right with the landlord's only remedy being termination plus a buy-out of unamortized improvements, and a no-consent assignment right with recapture only if the box stops being a supermarket. Percentage rent is 1% over a natural breakpoint. Watch items: §18(c) requires SUPERVALU Holdings to sign option exercises, and the assignment documents impose a $25M net-worth test — both should be confirmed for the 2019/2025 exercises.
